verdict: Not ready yet. Two wording ambiguities (Q1 and Q2c) change what well-prepared students answer and cost them points under the current rubric. Fix both, and either shorten Q3 or add five minutes: half the class ran out of time with Q3 unfinished.

recommendations.change: Replace with: '(c) Compute player 1's expected payoff in the mixed-strategy equilibrium from (b).'
recommendations.rationale: Five of eight students hesitated or chose different equilibria; the intended reading is only implicit.
evidence: grader flags on S03, S05, S07, S08

recommendations.change: Replace 'Eliminate dominated strategies iteratively' with 'Apply iterated elimination of strictly dominated strategies (IESDS)'.
recommendations.rationale: Weak dominance is a legitimate reading and gives a different answer, as S04's sheet shows.

recommendations.change: Either extend to 35 minutes or cut Q3 to the uniqueness part (4 points) and state the Nash-equilibrium part as given.
recommendations.rationale: Median time used is 29.5 of 30 minutes and four students ran out, all inside Q3.

recommendations.change: Split the statement into two sentences: the assumption, then '(i) Show s* is a Nash equilibrium. (ii) Show it is the only pure one.'
recommendations.rationale: Easier to parse for non-native readers and makes partial credit visible.
